_comment: The fonts this plugin declares to mPDF, and therefore the only ones the release ZIPs keep. mPDF ships ~88 MB of fonts; a build that keeps them all puts the free download over WordPress.org's upload limit. Services/Fonts.php reads this file and hands it to mPDF as its complete fontdata map, and the release script reads it to decide what to delete -- so the declaration and the shipped files cannot drift apart. mPDF decides what is AVAILABLE from the map, never from what is on disk: a family named here whose file is missing is a fatal at render time, not a warning.
